summary: Brief covers all six research steps: official print-file location and printer requirements (SIGRobotics-UIUC/LeKiwi 3DPrinting.md + TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 for the arm), an itemized print-vs-buy BOM extending the prior research's $482-499 figure plus new Dynamixel-variant ($770.47) and independent ($450-550) cost data points, a concrete 5-phase primary-sourced assembly sequence corroborated at a coarser level by an independent vendor wiki, a fully detailed software/firmware setup phase from official Hugging Face LeRobot docs with independent corroboration of setup friction points, and a substantive chapter-by-chapter mapping back to Modern Robotics building on the prior research's sketch. Reliability is generally strong (multiple primary/official sources plus independent corroboration for most claims), with the clearest weak spot being sparse independent evidence of physical print/assembly friction (only one experienced-builder account, reporting a smooth build) and an unreconciled, now four-way cost range -- both carried into Risks/Open questions rather than asserted as settled.
